title: Cited recipes whose finished weight needs no yield assumption
rules: A recipe qualifies only when its cooked weight is sourced. None of the 28 cited recipes states a measured cooked weight; the only defensible ones are dishes with no cooking step, whose finished weight is the weight of what goes in (checked at build time: within 1%).
Values are the catalog's composed values for the recipe (USDA ingredients, scripts/recipes.mjs), so this set checks recipe-level estimation, not laboratory analysis.
Every recipe not used is listed with its reason.
